card.name: Intravenous and IV before drug names
card.fires_on: The word intravenous (or its start, intr-avenous) and the abbreviation IV just before an IV drug name such as atropine or dextrose. Also fires on a few other words in drug-interaction or overdose text, such as increase after a drug name.
